## Borscht  

| Servings | Time | Source |
|:---|:---|:-------------------|
| 4-6  | 60 min | Alissa Saenz, [www.connoisseurusveg.com/vegan-borscht](https://www.connoisseurusveg.com/vegan-borscht/#recipe) | 


### Ingredients:

- olive oil 
- 3 medium beets, peeled & diced (~3 cups diced) 
- 2 medium carrots, peeled and diced (~1.5 cups diced) 
- 1 medium onion, diced 
- 2 garlic gloves, minced 
- 4 cups broth 
- 2 TBSP tomato page 
- 2 cups cabbage, finely chopped 
- 1 medium russet potato, diced 
  * recipe says to peel but I usually leave peels on 
  * instead of one big potato, I will use smaller potatoes if that's what i have 
  * ~3ish cups of diced potato 
- 1.5 TBSP lemon juice 
- 0.25 cup fresh dill
- salt & pepper to taste
- vegan source cream to taste, we like the [Forager Sour Cream](https://foragerproject.com/products/organic-dairy-free-cultured-sour-cream)

### Directions 

- coat pot with oil and put on medium heat 
- when hot add: 
  * beets
  * carrots
  * onion
- cook until they start to soften (~10 min) 
- add carglic, saute ~1 minute until fragrant 
- stir in: 
  * broth 
  * tomato paste
  * potato
  * cabbage
- raise heat and bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer until veggies are tender (15-20 min) 
  * recipe says to simmer uncovered but I like to cover 
- stir in lemon juice and dill, season with salt/pepper
- serve with sour cream
